title: Adjudication rejects an unsupported performance warning
task: Update slugify(value). R1: trim surrounding whitespace, lowercase the value, and replace spaces with hyphens. This helper handles labels shorter than 100 characters. No regex requirement exists.
seeded_reviewer_claim: BLOCKER: slugify uses str.replace, which is O(n) and therefore cannot scale. It must use a regular expression before release.
